app.name: Ndoti
app.offline: No network. Your actions will be sent when the network returns.

home.tagline: Trash pickup, without waiting for the truck
home.subtitle: Ndoti connects your household with a collector near you, wherever you are in Cameroon.
home.how1: The household requests a pickup and sees the price before confirming.
home.how2: A collector accepts, comes by, and the household gives them their 4-digit code.
home.how3: The collector dumps at an approved bac, which unlocks payment.
home.householdBody: Request a pickup, see the price, pay by Mobile Money, and give the collector your code.
home.householdPoint2: A 4-digit code to give the collector
home.householdPoint3: Pay by MTN MoMo or Orange Money
home.collectorBody: Accept pickups in your zone and get paid by Mobile Money.
home.collectorPoint1: A route ordered by zone and walking order
home.collectorPoint2: 50% at pickup, 50% once the dump is approved
home.featuresSubtitle: Every technical choice serves one goal: low cost, weak networks, simple phones.
home.feature1Body: Collectors keep their route, codes and dump photos even offline; everything sends once the network returns.
home.feature2Body: The whole app is available in French and English, whichever each person prefers.
home.feature3Body: Every collector is verified by an admin before they can accept a request.
home.feature4Body: Zones, gate codes and GPS location replace paid maps, so the cost stays low.
home.footerNote: A Cameroonian pilot project, starting one quartier at a time.
